tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.take: The only college game on a Sunday slate, and it only exists because of a travel mess: Friday's nationwide FAA ground stop kept Ole Miss in Mississippi, and the SEC moved the game from Saturday to noon Sunday — over Oklahoma's public objection. No. 17 Ole Miss (6-3) visits Oklahoma (5-4) in Norman, and the travel disruption is the story: the Rebels arrived a day late into a hostile noon kickoff. Our fair number makes Oklahoma a 55.7% favorite, and no price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge, but the lean is Oklahoma -2.5: the home team, the fresher week, and a Rebels side that spent its prep day in an airport.
games.title: Ole Miss at Oklahoma: the Sunday college game
games.venue: Gaylord Family-Oklahoma Memorial Stadium, Norman, OK
games.verdict: LEAN: OU -2.5 — no true edge; the home team with the cleaner week against a travel-weary visitor.
games.weather: Cold and dry in Norman; no NWS watch or warning.

games.take: Kansas City (6-2) comes off its best offensive day of the season, a 35-12 win over the Jets, and faces an Atlanta team (3-6) that has lost four of its last five, including a 34-17 loss to Cincinnati in Madrid and a 16-0 shutout at Tampa Bay. Mahomes' elbow is cleared and he practiced fully, but Kenneth Walker III is OUT with a groin injury after his three-touchdown day — that could push Kansas City to throw more, which is the headwind on our Mahomes Under 1.5 pass TDs board play (+120, +1.6% EV). Our fair number makes the Chiefs a 63.1% favorite, and the least-bad price in the game is the Over 47.5 at -103 (+0.2% EV) — still below the bar. No true edge on the side, but the lean is Kansas City -3: the better team against a Falcons side in freefall.
games.title: Chiefs at Falcons: the early favorite
games.verdict: LEAN: KC -3.0 — no true edge on the side; the better team against a Falcons side that has lost four of five.

games.take: The quarterback story of the day: Kirk Cousins starts for Minnesota at Lambeau, less than a week after the Vikings re-acquired him from the Raiders, with Kyler Murray out (hamstring) and Carson Wentz coming off a 6-of-23, two-interception showing in Buffalo. The Vikings (6-2) are also without T.J. Hockenson and Jauan Jennings, and Jordan Addison is questionable. Green Bay (6-3) has its own outs — Josh Jacobs (finger) and Micah Parsons (knee/illness) — but the Packers' defense has played at a top-five rate over the past month. Our fair number makes Green Bay a 58.0% favorite, and no price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge, but the lean is Green Bay -2.5: the home favorite against a quarterback making his first start for a new team on a short week.
games.title: Vikings at Packers: Cousins walks back into Lambeau
games.verdict: LEAN: GB -2.5 — no true edge; the home favorite against a QB starting his first game for a new team.
games.weather: Cold in Green Bay; no NWS watch or warning.

games.take: The biggest total on the board at 55.5, and the marquee afternoon game: San Francisco (7-1) visits Dallas (4-5). The 49ers are without Mike Evans (Achilles) for a third straight game and Trent Williams is questionable, but Deebo Samuel is cleared to play and George Pickens is back for Dallas while Jake Ferguson is out. Our fair number makes the 49ers a 65.8% favorite, and no price clears our 0.75% bar — the market has this one priced about right. No true edge, but the lean is San Francisco -4.5: the 7-1 team with the better defense, laying less than a touchdown in a shootout script.
games.title: 49ers at Cowboys: the biggest total on the board
games.verdict: LEAN: SF -4.5 — no true edge; the 7-1 team laying less than a touchdown in a shootout script.

games.take: First place in the AFC North is on the line on Sunday night: both teams are 6-2 and riding four-game win streaks. Pittsburgh took the first meeting 30-27 in Week 3 as a 3.5-point home underdog, and the Steelers come off a bye — a spot where they are 6-0 against the spread in their last six and 8-0 straight up in their last eight. Aaron Rodgers has thrown 13 touchdowns and Pittsburgh is 6-2 ATS this season. Our fair number makes Cincinnati a 63.4% favorite at home, and no price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge, but the lean is Cincinnati -3.5: the home team in a coin-flip division race, with the bye angle as the honest headwind on the other side.
games.title: Steelers at Bengals: first place in the AFC North
games.verdict: LEAN: CIN -3.5 — no true edge; the home team, with Pittsburgh's bye record as the honest headwind.
games.weather: Cold evening in Cincinnati; no NWS watch or warning.

games.take: This one carries real edges — two of them are on our board. Phoenix +143 is +1.3% EV against devigged Pinnacle, and Luka Doncic Over 4.5 Threes at -115 is +1.3% EV against devigged FanDuel. The Suns (5-6) are home, Devin Booker just dropped 30 in a 133-110 win over the Clippers, and the 11-2 Lakers are laying only 2.5 on the road. Luka has made 55 threes in his last 10 games (5.5 a night) and cleared 4.5 in 9 of 10. The lean is Phoenix +143 — the home dog at a price the sharp fair says is a touch too long.
games.title: Lakers at Suns: two edges on the board
games.verdict: LEAN: PHX +143 — a real edge (+1.3% EV); the home dog priced a touch too long.

games.take: The widest NBA number of the day: Boston is an 86.5% favorite on our fair number, laying 13.5 at TD Garden. Dallas is on the road in the early evening window, and the market expects a comfortable Celtics win. No price clears our 0.75% bar — the least-bad number is Boston -625 on the exchange (+0.4% EV), which is not a bettable edge. No true edge, but the lean is Boston -13.5: the far better team at home, and the points are the only way to play a favorite this short.
games.title: Mavericks at Celtics: the widest NBA number
games.verdict: LEAN: BOS -13.5 — no true edge; the far better team at home, and the points are the only way to play it.

games.take: The nightcap: Oklahoma City is an 81.0% favorite on our fair number, laying 10.5 in Sacramento. The Thunder are the class of the West and the market prices them like it — no price clears our 0.75% bar, with the least-bad number OKC -10.5 at -105 (+0.2% EV), still below the bar. No true edge, but the lean is Oklahoma City -10.5: the better team by a wide margin, and the spread is the only playable side of a -466 moneyline.
games.title: Thunder at Kings: the nightcap
games.verdict: LEAN: OKC -10.5 — no true edge; the better team by a wide margin, and the spread is the only playable side.
